window.title: Where agents open their tabs
window.description: Open agent tabs in the current browser window or in a separate window.

grouping.title: Group agent tabs
grouping.description: Group agent tabs into one shared group, one group per session, or none.

groupCollapse.title: Collapse agent groups
groupCollapse.description: Collapse agent groups automatically when inactive, or leave them as set in the tab strip.

idleMinutes.title: Close idle tabs after
idleMinutes.description: Minutes an agent tab may sit untouched before closing (0 never closes tabs).

humanInput.title: Human-like input
humanInput.description: Use curved mouse paths, paced typing, and gliding scroll.

handoffNotifications.title: Handoff notifications
handoffNotifications.description: Show system notifications only on recorded tabs or on every handoff.

browserName.title: Name for agents
browserName.description: Name used to identify this browser when multiple browsers connect to one relay.

relayAddress.title: Relay address
relayAddress.description: Relay host or host:port (for example localhost:19988 or a Tailscale host).

autoPairLocalRelay.title: Auto-pair with local relay
autoPairLocalRelay.description: Automatically pair an unpaired browser with a local loopback relay when the relay also enables OPENCODE_BROWSER_AUTO_PAIR_LOCAL=1.
